page.overview:
Who is Brotwu?

Brotwu was a male individual and the father of Brotwu. Along with their family whom all shared the same name, Brotwu ended up stranded on The Island of a planet, and became some of the many inhabitants known as Castaways who called the island home. On The Island, Brotwu ran a cantina named Brotwu's. Over the years, the Brotwu family had been good to their fellow residents of The Island, leaving a lasting impact of admiration among the Castaways. Brotwu eventually passed down ownership of the cantina to their progeny, Brotwu.

Brotwu was mentioned in the 2021 mobile game LEGO Star Wars: Castaways.
